Logan: Heads-up: final release window Fri 10:00am PT. Final cutoff for changelog entries is Thu 6:00pm PT. Please make sure entries follow the release template and include component tags. pinging @eng-release-owners :wave:
Maya: Ack — I'll do a sweep of infra & runtime entries Thu morning.
Ada: Quick Q — what's the minimal required format? bullets, header, examples? Could we paste the template here?
Logan: Minimal = one-line summary + component tag. Prefer the Keep-a-Changelog style but compact. Example: `Fix: avoid double-free in KV cache (runtime)` or `Improve: batching heuristics (serving/runtime)`. Use prefixes like Fix, Add, Improve, Remove, Deprecate.
Priya: Also note: for big user-facing changes add a short explanatory sentence under the one-liner (2–3 sentences). For internal infra tweaks the one-liner is usually enough.
devex-bot: Quick links: https://redwood.dev/release-template and run the linter with `/changelog-lint`. Bot will post failures as review comments.
Ada: thx — pasting a tiny template snippet for copy/paste:
```
- component: runtime
- one_liner: Fix tokenization off-by-one that truncated long prompts
- notes: caused by change in tokenizer behavior; added test coverage and regression guard
```
Maya: I'll run `/changelog-lint` across open PRs now and share a short results list.
Logan: If lint fails, either fix or @release-leads can opt to accept with a comment. Reminder: we do NOT put internal URLs or stack traces in the one-liner. Keep phrasing user-safe.
Priya: Also, tag the PR title with the component when possible — helps triage during release cutover.
Ada: will do. Also please tag PR numbers in the changelog entry line if it's not obvious.
Logan: :thumbsup: Thanks. I'll create a tiny checklist doc and post a channel reminder Thu 5:00pm PT for last-call.
Maya: +1
Priya: Anyone available Fri AM to help draft the release notes after we collate entries?
Ada: I can help 9:00–11:00 PT.
Maya: I can take 11:00–13:00 PT.
Logan: Perfect — I'll assign those slots in the checklist and follow up. If you see any borderline one-liners, please flag them here rather than silently changing wording.
Maya: noted. I'll post any rejects as a short thread with suggested wording.
Logan: thanks all — let's keep entries tight and machine-lintable. :hammer:
